web.title: Gemini API Free Tier 2026: Limits, Free Models, and API Keys
web.description:
Yes—the Gemini API still has a free tier in 2026. Free-tier limits are measured in requests per minute (RPM), tokens per minute (TPM), and requests per day (RPD); they apply per project, not per API key, and RPD resets at midnight Pacific.

## Quick answer
| Question | Current answer on June 30, 2026 |
|-|-|
| Is the "20 RPD" free-tier limit real? | It can be real for a specific project or model state, but it is not a safe universal number to copy into code. Read AI Studio for the exact project, model, tier, and billing state. |

web.description:
# Gemini API Free Tier (September 2026): Every Rate Limit, Quota, and Gotcha
## Free Tier Rate Limits by Model
| Model | RPM | TPM | RPD | Context |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| **Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite** | 15 | 250,000 | 1,000 | 1M tokens |

Gemini 2.0 Flash and the newer Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite are the most generous on requests per minute.

## Gemini 3 Flash Free Tier Limits
On the free tier it runs 10 requests per minute, 250,000 tokens per minute, and 1,500 requests per day.

At a steady 1 request per minute you run for 25 hours of clock time before the daily cap resets, which means a low-traffic app fits comfortably.

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What are the rate limits on Gemini's free tier?
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite gets 15 RPM with a 1,000 RPD cap.
